column3: Close to the Hebrew; “if your servant is good before you” is rendered “has found favor in your sight.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the citadel which belongs to the house” is rendered “pertains to the temple.”
Close to the Hebrew; הָעֶבֶד (“the servant”) is rendered “official.”
Close to the Hebrew; הַתַּנִּין (“dragons, jackals”) spring is rendered “Serpent Well,” and the Dung Gate “the Refuse Gate.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Tobiah the servant” is rendered “the Ammonite official.”
Close to the Hebrew; חֵלֶק (“a share, portion”) is rendered “heritage.”
